empowered.name: Empowered Spell
empowered.description: Reroll some of the spell's damage dice.

heightened.name: Heightened Spell
heightened.description: One target of the spell has Disadvantage on its first save against it.

quickened.name: Quickened Spell
quickened.description: Cast a spell that takes an action as a Bonus Action.

twinned.name: Twinned Spell
twinned.description: A spell that targets one creature targets one more.
